basic_info.description: A traditional 2 bedroom home located in one of the most desirable neighborhood of Balboa Terrace. It is proximity to West Portal, Stonestown Galleria, freeway access and public transportation. This property embodies both character and old world charm. Beautiful exterior outlook with matured landscaping. Abundance of natural light enters through the picture windows in the living room.  Lovely ornate fireplace with built-in hutches. Formal dining room to entertain. Breakfast nook adjacent to the spacious kitchen. Hardwood Floors, 2 car S/S garage. This property has been in the same family for over 55 years. With some TLC and your special touches. It can be brought back to its timeless beauty! Trust sale.
